同一局域网，无需隧道: Same local network; no tunnel needed
本机网络不支持 IPv6: This network does not support IPv6
NAS 未提供可用的公网 IPv6: NAS has no available public IPv6 address
NAS 已禁用公网 IPv6 访问: Public IPv6 access is disabled on the NAS
等待下一次直连检测: Waiting for the next direct connection check
用户名或密码无效，请重试: Invalid username or password. Try again.
登录已失效，请重新输入密码: Your session has expired. Enter your password again.
该账号权限不足，无法完成授权: This account does not have permission to authorize.
暂时无法连接 fnOS，请检查网络后重试: Cannot connect to fnOS. Check your network and try again.
该账号需要两步验证，当前版本暂不支持: This account requires two-factor authentication, which is not supported yet.
在浏览器中打开 NAS 管理页面: Open NAS administration in your browser
请重新登录 FnCPN。当前隧道连接不受影响。: Sign in to FnCPN again. Your tunnel connection is unaffected.
连接可能需要特权服务，请确认已安装或重新授权。: The connection may require the privileged service. Check its installation or authorize again.
请在系统设置中允许 FnCPN 访问本地网络，然后重试。: Allow FnCPN to access the local network in System Settings, then try again.
管理后台仅对 fnOS 管理员账号开放: Administration is available only to fnOS administrators
本地与 NAS 网段重叠，仅保留隧道内 NAS 路由: Local and NAS subnets overlap; only the NAS route inside the tunnel is retained
该页面仅管理员可以访问。请使用管理员账号登录后重试。: Only administrators can access this page. Sign in with an administrator account and try again.
状态未知，不能删除: Cannot delete a device with unknown status
删除设备“{0}”（{1}）？此操作会移除该设备的注册记录和隧道配置。: Delete device “{0}” ({1})? This removes its registration and tunnel configuration.
设备已不存在，已取消删除。: The device no longer exists. Deletion canceled.
设备已上线，已取消删除。: The device is now online. Deletion canceled.
设备状态不可确认，已取消删除。: The device status is unknown. Deletion canceled.
修改 Overlay 会重新分配全部设备地址并中断现有连接。继续吗？: Changing the Overlay reassigns all device addresses and interrupts existing connections. Continue?
操作所需条件尚未满足。: The requirements for this operation are not met.
设备授权已撤销，请重新登录。: Device access was revoked. Sign in again.
目标不存在，请刷新后重试。: The requested item was not found. Refresh and retry.
请求超时，请重试。: The request timed out. Try again.
网络地址发现失败，请检查网络。: Address discovery failed. Check your network.
操作失败，请重试或查看诊断详情。: Operation failed. Retry or review the diagnostics.
无法连接服务，请检查网络后重试。: Cannot reach the service. Check your network and retry.
权限不足，无法完成操作。: You do not have permission to perform this operation.
版本不兼容，请升级客户端。: Versions are incompatible. Update the client.
版本不兼容，请升级服务端。: Versions are incompatible. Update the server.
本地组件版本不一致，请完成更新并重新启动 FnCPN。: Local component versions differ. Complete the update and restart FnCPN.
未找到 FnCPN 服务，请在 fnOS 安装或启动 FnCPN 后重新连接。: FnCPN server was not found. Install or start FnCPN on fnOS, then connect again.
